stepBody: A DS100 student wants to run gradient descent on the total zero-one loss to find optimal $$\hat{\beta}_{ZO}$$ and $$\hat{T}_{ZO}.$$ Give the very specific reason that this will always fail. Answer in $$10$$ words or less. Vague answers will be given no credit.
answerLatex: The gradient is always $$0$$, so gradient descent never moves.
choices: The zero one loss is not convex, so it has local minima.
The gradient is always $$0$$, so gradient descent never moves.
The zero one loss is unbounded below, so the updates diverge.
No learning rate is small enough for the updates to converge.
The zero one loss has no closed form solution for its optimum.
